prompt: Create a mobile TripLOG itinerary summary UI concept at 390 CSS pixels wide. White day card, pale blue Day 1 badge, dark navy Korean text, compact category emoji icons. Show 13:00 나리타공항, 15:00 니시스가모 호텔, 16:40 멘야무사시 along a thin vertical timeline. Between stops, show small transport icons, route names and minutes in a horizontal sequence on the plain white card with no chip backgrounds, borders or enclosing boxes. A missing duration uses a small amber question mark. At the card bottom, use a compact button labeled “일정 다듬기” with a pencil icon and right chevron, using TripLOG's yellow accent, dark outline and small offset shadow. Keep the hierarchy compact, readable and consistent with the app.
implementation: Retain current compact timeline and real runtime category SVGs. Apply plain transport rows and the yellow outlined itinerary action; do not add generated sample narration or date changes.
